description: Whole-scope (sub-process) compensation (#901): `sub` contains compensable `bookA` and a nested `sub2` containing compensable `bookB`. When the sub-process completes, the root compensation throw (no activityRef) triggers EVERY in-scope handler — cancelA directly and cancelB through the nested scope subscriptions (Zeebe `triggerCompensationFromTopToBottom`) — and rests until both complete. Completing the first handler must NOT route the throw onward.
